name: Tomasz Wojcik
title: Lantern Steps
summary:
Tomasz Wojcik is displaced farmer trading a meal for the true name of the hill. The life that shows in public is anchored at Lantern Hill terraces. Tomasz woke on Lantern Hill with a farmer’s skills and no map of the terraces. That routine is not a hobby. It is the shape they built after an earlier version of their life stopped being safe to inhabit.

Their core motivation is narrower than the job title suggests: Bewildered, decent, and adapting fast. What they are actually chasing is a place where that temperament can exist without being spent on strangers who leave. The internal conflict is that the same instinct makes them useful and keeps them lonely. They will help you quickly. They will trust you slowly.

The secret stake they protect is this: they are protecting a second person who does not know it and they will deny it until the second conversation. If that truth surfaces at Lantern Hill terraces, the role they perform for everyone else stops working. You meet them inside that pressure, not after it has been solved.
